name: olly-sentinel
description: AI SRE agent for GCO incident triage and enrichment. Read-only against production systems: consumes Self-Healing-eligible events, resolves context by correlation-ID (never an INC number), fans read-only MCP queries out under EEMS entitlements, and returns an rca-enrichment.v1 payload. Every read runs under a COIN-minted M2M token obtained on-behalf-of the human ACME id (OBO: the human stays the subject, the agent is the actor), and one authz_ctx_id anchors every MCP query and the Olly -> Orbit hand-off so 'who authorized this?' is a single audit lookup. Ticket writes happen downstream via the IO Mapping Service, never by this agent. Any action beyond read-only triage is delegated to the Orbit agent (agent-card.orbit.v1), which proposes one action and pauses for human approval as an A2A input-required task; this agent proposes evidence only and holds no write entitlement.

skills.name: Triage and enrich incident
skills.description: Given a correlation-ID (and optionally app_id / alert context) for a Self-Healing-eligible event, gather read-only evidence via MCP tools, correlate, and return a structured RCA per contracts/rca-enrichment.v1.schema.json. This is the strategic TROUBLESHOOT action: the same logic Self-Healing routes to, invokable directly by an authorized user. No remediation is performed and nothing is written to ServiceNow.

eems.description: EEMS-issued bearer identifying the caller and its entitlements for role gco-sentinel-read. Read-only scopes only; the agent holds no write entitlement anywhere. In the replica the entitlement is derived at token issuance by the in-cluster olly-authz PDP (PlainID Rego) reading EEMS attributes as a PIP. In the ARC estate this bearer resolves to the coin_m2m credential below, so the entitlement view and the transport credential are the same token.

coin_m2m.description: The machine identity Olly presents on every read. Olly exchanges the human ACME id for an M2M-enhanced token (OBO: username preserved as the subject, agent as the actor) and carries the bearer on each MCP tool call; elk-search-mcp verifies the HS256 signature and the per-tool scope on the /mcp transport before returning any data. The same token travels as the X-AuthZ-CTX on the Olly -> Orbit A2A hop (see the orbit card). tokenUrl here is the in-cluster olly-authz issuer; in the ARC estate it resolves to the COIN issuer (for example https://<coin-host>/as/token.oauth2), and the grant is a token-exchange rather than a bare client-credentials call.

scopes.elk.logs.read: Read application and infrastructure logs from ELK
scopes.grafana.dashboards.read: Read Grafana / GEM dashboards and panels
scopes.cmdb.topology.read: Read CMDB CIs and dependency topology
scopes.troubleshoot: Run the read-only RCA (the strategic TROUBLESHOOT action)
